# Kering

> > Global luxury group managing iconic fashion and jewelry Houses including Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, and Kering Eyewear.

Kering is a Paris-based luxury conglomerate committed to sustainable innovation, craftsmanship preservation, and talent development across its portfolio of prestigious fashion, leather goods, and jewelry brands. The company leads the industry in environmental measurement through its EP&L tool and champions diversity and inclusion initiatives.

- [Gucci | Couture & Leather Goods](https://www.kering.com/en/houses/couture-and-leather-goods/gucci): Gucci: Florence-born luxury House founded 1921, joined Kering 1999
- [Creativity is our legacy: Kering's signature](https://www.kering.com/en/group/discover-kering/creativity-is-our-legacy): Kering's creative vision and legacy across luxury brand portfolio

## Sustainability & Innovation

- [EP&L: environmental measurement tool for sustainable Luxury](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/measuring-our-impact/our-ep-l): Environmental Profit & Loss (EP&L) tool measures Kering's impact
- [Innovation Labs to reduce environmental footprint](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/innovating-for-tomorrow/innovation-labs): Material Innovation Lab in Milan driving sustainable materials research
- [Kering commitments for respect of human rights](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/people-in-the-supply-chain): Kering's human rights commitments and supply chain sustainability efforts
- [Engagement in preserving know-how and craftsmanship](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/people-in-the-supply-chain/preserving-craftsmanship): Kering preserves craftsmanship through partnerships with specialized schools
- [Kering and BSR tackle resilience to Climate Change for Luxury fashion](https://www.kering.com/en/news/bsr-tackle-resilience-climate-change-luxury-fashion): Kering and BSR publish climate change resilience report for luxury fashion
